title: Contraherent cosheaves of contramodules on Noetherian formal schemes
summary: There are two main results in this paper: the MGM equivalence between the conventional derived categories of abelian/exact categories, and the derived co-contra correspondence (i.e., an equivalence between the coderived and the contraderived category). Firstly, for any Noetherian formal scheme that is either of finite Krull dimension or semi-separated, we construct a triangulated equivalence between the conventional unbounded derived categories of the abelian category of quasi-coherent torsion sheaves and the exact category of contraherent cosheaves of contramodules.
